name: Puff Pastry Sticks with Cinnamon Sugar, Coconut & Chocolate Chips (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Remove the puff pastry from box and outer wrapping, then set on the counter to thaw slightly, 20-40 minutes. (The pastry is ready when it unfolds easily but is still cool to the touch.)
Meanwhile, place sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp granulated sugar
½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place water, chocolate chips, and coconut each in their own additional small bowls. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup water
½ cup mini chocolate chips
½ cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: When the puff pastry is thawed, preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Place egg in another small bowl and whisk to combine. Set the egg wash aside.
Unroll both sheets of puff pastry and cut each lengthwise into thirds. Cut each piece crosswise in half (you should now have 12 pieces of puff pastry, 3 each for 4 people).

Brush a small amount of water onto a piece of puff pastry, then sprinkle evenly with a small amount of your choice of toppings. Cover with a second piece of pastry, then repeat with water and toppings. Cover with a third piece of pastry and gently press to secure the layers.

Cut the layered puff pastry lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips. Twist each strip once, then arrange on the baking sheets, leaving 1-inch of space between each slice. Gently press each end to secure the twist, then brush tops with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until pastry is golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Show off your creations, share, and enjoy!
